page.overview:
Who is Deku Tree Sprout?

The is a recurring character in . It is the son of the Great Deku Tree from .

In , Link first encounters the Deku Tree Sprout after awakening Saria as the Forest Sage by defeating Phantom Ganon. Upon landing safely in front of the withered remains of the original Deku Tree in the Great Deku Tree's Meadow, Link himself will be thrown back screaming by the Deku Tree Sprout suddenly rising from the ground directly in front of him. The Deku Tree Sprout thanks the hero for breaking the 's curse and excitedly informs him that as his fellow Kokiri evidently have not matured alongside him after 7 years, as he is not of their kind and is in fact a Hylian. The Deku Tree Sprout elaborates that Link's Mother fled from the Hyrulean Civil War with her infant child into the Kokiri Forest seeking asylum. Seeing that the woman was mortally wounded and sensing that the boy was fated to change the world, the Deku Tree agreed to take the child in and raise him as a Kokiri. Having revealed the details to Link's destiny as the Hero of Time, the Deku Tree Sprout urges him to free the remaining Sages to bring peace to Hyrule once more.

The Deku Tree Sprout appears at the end of the .

When Lana uses the Spear Weapon, she is capable of summoning the Deku Tree Sprout to assist her in battle. The Deku Tree Sprout appears in many of Lana's strong attacks, either bouncing around, zig-zaging through enemies, or dashing straight through them. Lana is also capable of summoning three at a time with her sixth strong attack in her standard attack string. Her Focus Spirit Special allows her to summon a Deku Tree Sprout and ride it. As it rushes forward, she will thrust it in the direction she's facing.
